data.title: 古手川唯 · 睡前镜台的柔发梳理
data.description: 洗完澡后的卧室飘着淡淡皂香，古手川唯换上浅粉真丝吊带睡裙坐在木质矮镜台前，轻柔地梳理垂落腰间的漆黑长发。听见轻敲门声时她停下梳子微微回首，平日严厉的眉眼在暖黄台灯下化开，只余几分羞怯与柔软。
data.location: 弥漫浴后暖意的少女卧室矮镜台前
data.action: 坐于镜台前停下梳发动作，略带羞涩地回眸相望
data.lighting: 暖黄床头台灯映出真丝柔和光泽与温润肤色
data.camera: 四分之三中近景，镜台与木梳入画
data.mood: 柔和、卸下防备后的少女娇羞
data.promptProse: Seated on a floor cushion before her low wooden mirror after a bath, Yui pauses mid-stroke with her wooden hairbrush as she glances back toward the door. Soft amber lamplight shines across her pale-pink sheer silk camisole and smooth dark hair, catching a shy flush across her cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Pausing with her hairbrush before the low vanity mirror, she turns back with a shy blush in the warm lamplight.
data.nsfwProse: Slender shoulder straps and white lace neckline trim trace her collarbone over the translucent pale-pink silk.
